plugins.name: crabwatch
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live panel of subagents with model, context, cost and time.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: File tree of the working folder with git status, lines changed, and a shimmer on files Claude reads or writes.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Warming pings cost tokens.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, find -delete, xargs rm, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations, also inside bash -c and sudo) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time, with /replay.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Offers to turn a long, loose prompt into a brief (Goal, Context, Limits, Done when), with up to three questions on what it leaves open.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A task bar above the prompt that fills as Claude's to-do list is done, and a Helpers pane with one live card per subagent (/helpers).

plugins.name: decision-tree
plugins.description: When Claude ends a reply with a question, a side pane explains the choice, recommendation first, and lets you try any option, or your own, in a forked session.

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that keeps every diagram Claude draws, a live map of the work, and lets you go into boxes and change them.
